extraction_notes: The requested exact identity LH8550QLT1G is listed in the p. 1 device ordering table with marking KIY; the shared datasheet title is LH8550PLT1G Series, S-LH8550PLT1G Series. Manufacturer normalized to the requested identity LRC, corresponding to Leshan Radio Company, Ltd.

The supplied PDF identifies the device as a PNP silicon transistor. PNP signed voltage and current values are retained in table fields and digitized curve points; the characteristic plots themselves show positive-magnitude axes.

Electrical characteristics are headed TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted. Page 3 characteristic curves show typical traces at TA = 25 degC, 100 degC, and -25 degC; plotted points are approximate manual digitizations at visible grid positions with no interpolation between observations.

The p. 2 DC current gain table publishes hFE = 100 minimum and 320 maximum at IC = -100 mA, VCE = -1 V, plus hFE = 40 minimum at IC = -800 mA, VCE = -1 V. Guaranteed bounds are retained as separate points and are not converted into typical values.

The p. 2 saturation table publishes one maximum VCE(sat) row at IC = -800 mA and IB = -80 mA. No VBE(sat) value or second saturation pair is published, so vbe_sat is null and no additional table point was invented.
The p. 2 table publishes VBE = -0.66 V typical and -1 V maximum at VCE = -1 V, IC = -10 mA; VBE is not represented by this strict schema and the value is recorded here for traceability.

The supplied datasheet does not tabulate fT, Cobo, or Cibo; those fields are null. Additional absolute ratings not represented by this schema are V(BR)CBO = -50 V, V(BR)EBO = -6 V, IC = -1.5 A, PD = 225 mW, and junction/storage temperature range -55 to +150 degC, from p. 1.
omission_reason: No numeric fT, Cobo, or Cibo values are published in the supplied datasheet. No VBE(sat) value or second saturation pair is published; additional absolute-rating fields beyond VCEO are not represented by this strict schema.
